manual_notes: Feature and ProjectBundle extension dictionaries, contracts, serialization and registry introspection are real. Strict conflict behavior is unresolved: registration catches extension collisions and continues registering the module, despite the requirement to fail second-module registration. Registry also compares target/field across different module names rather than the full namespaced key. Thus selected whole-system scope is partial, not an abandonment label.
